command:
for n in /sys/bus/i2c/devices/2-002b /sys/bus/i2c/devices/2-0041; do printf '
DEVICE %s
' "$n"; ls -la "$n"; cat "$n/name" 2>/dev/null || true; readlink -f "$n/driver"; if [ -f "$n/of_node/compatible" ]; then tr '\000' '
' < "$n/of_node/compatible"; fi; done; printf '
KERNEL
'; dmesg | grep -Ei 'lt9611|hdmi|hpd|edid|drm|dsi' | tail -n 90; printf '
INTERRUPTS
'; grep -Ei 'lt9611|hdmi|dsi|msm_drm' /proc/interrupts || true
